_meta.scope: Li Auto Inc. (LI, CIK 1791706) as-reported correction of 12 cells: 4 opInc quarters, 4 opInc fiscal years, 2 FY2021 + 1 2021Q3 rd/sga reclassification cells
_meta.why: 12 cells were taken from stockanalysis normalized statements instead of the company's as-reported consolidated statements of operations. For opInc, stockanalysis subtracts its own 'Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets' line from the reported income/(loss) from operations; the company's reported operating income already includes disposal gains/losses. For 2021 rd/sga the third party reclassified 10.762 (2021Q3) / 52.985 (FY2021) from R&D to SG&A, total unchanged. Values below are the as-reported CNY-M figures from the SEC 6-K earnings releases (and the FY2021 20-F cross-check).
_meta.fields_note: Only rd, sga and opInc are written; row key order and every other field/row stay byte-identical. Loaded by scripts/patch_rows_2026-11-26_li.mjs (targeted, verifies disk value === old) and by scripts/merge_batches.mjs on every write path (before the reconcile pass), so a full --out-dir rebuild reproduces the corrected values instead of restoring the stockanalysis ones. Do NOT source future LI Q4 rows from stockanalysis: derive Q4 = FY - Q1 - Q2 - Q3 from as-reported values (known SA deltas 2023Q4 66.107 / 2024Q4 18.439 / 2025Q4 -48.971).
